item.title: Young girl finds whale stranded on Australian beach
item.description: The humpback whale later successfully freed itself after the tide rose in Queensland, Australia.

item.title: Watch: What we know about suspected crime boss Daniel Kinahan
item.description: Suspected crime boss Daniel Kinahan, one of the world's most wanted men, has spent his first night in custody in Ireland after being extradited from Dubai.

item.title: Watch: Moment powerful earthquake shakes Colombia and crumbles buildings
item.description: At least 111 people have been killed and dozens more injured after the 7.4 temblor hit the western part of the country, according to local officials.

item.description: At least 169 people are dead and a state of emergency has been declared after Colombia was hit by one of its largest earthquakes in years.

item.title: Australia is the planet's extinction hotspot, but one animal offers a glimmer of hope
item.description: The country is home to some of the world's most unique species - but it is losing them at an alarming rate.

item.title: Hundreds arrested over French wildfires, but who is to blame?
item.description: The government is trying to attribute blame for the unprecedented fires which tore through the country last month.

item.title: The lonely Chinese men being conned by fake brides
item.description: "Flash marriage" scams are an extreme symptom of a demographic crisis long in the making in China.

item.title: The transgender controversy surrounding the WNBA

item.title: New train service connects Finland and Sweden for first time in decades
item.description: The service will enable rail travel from Portugal to Lapland - what is believed to be the longest train journey in Europe.

item.title: Jackie, the famous California bald eagle, dies after weeks of intensive care
item.description: Jackie and her partner, Shadow, had been watched by millions of people over the years through the Big Bear Eagle Nest Cam.

item.description: The trial of the 63-year-old former gang boss kicked off on Monday, and he has entered a not guilty plea.

item.title: Trump signs order to limit childhood vaccines and split MMR shots
item.description: The American Academy of Pediatrics calls the recommendation on measles, mumps and rubella shots "dangerous".

item.title: Canada flight cancelled after child refuses to wear seat belt
item.description: The incident has sparked a debate over child safety and discipline on commercial planes.

item.description: An ex-Japanese envoy said the "sexist" comments "betrayed the close bond" between the countries.

item.description: Authorities promise tough new laws in the country, which has high levels of firearms ownership.

item.description: The attack was reportedly carried out by Iranian proxy on a small cargo ship, as tensions in region over the US-Iran conflict remain high.

item.description: Mangione's lawyers have yet to signal their defence, while prosecutors are in a battle over evidence.

item.description: More than 480 people were injured in the quakes, with more feared trapped under collapsed buildings.

item.title: Ousted Syrian dictator Bashar al-Assad sentenced to death in absentia
item.description: The ex-president is convicted of committing war crimes and crimes against humanity during the country's civil war.

item.title: Russia using North Korean missiles to strike Ukraine, Zelensky says
item.description: Ukraine's president says strikes in Zaporizhzhia - which killed at least six and injured 19 - involved ballistic missiles from Russia's ally.

item.title: Trump hid in catering truck in secret plane swap over Iran threat, reports say
item.description: The US president was reportedly part of a ruse where reporters were falsely told he was with them on Air Force One leaving a Nato summit in Turkey.
